observations: The first Cursor request was refused because its owner was not yet a steven member; the tester fixed membership and sent a new message to the QA pool. The initial failed claim is retained in evidence.

The new request was received and claimed at 13:06:48 UTC. Its QA workspace build started at 13:06:51 UTC and reached runner handoff 12.1 seconds later, with a connected, healthy agent and the expected cur:qa-cursor pool marker.

An INFO pending-request event was recorded for the new request. The tester explicitly confirmed a visible Cursor reply. The prompt was not tagged with a preassigned run ID; the operator correlated the build privately by workspace ID and timestamp. No transcript content or exact UI reply timestamp was collected.
The initial claim-failure counter stayed at one during the passing attempt, and the Relay reaped the finished Cursor workspace without selecting a Claude workspace.
cleanup: Relay queued deletion at 13:18:45 UTC after the session finished. At 13:22 UTC no steven QA workspaces remained; no manual deletion was needed.
